base.title: Base asset
base.description: Asset symbol shared by both legs, without the quote currency.

long_exchange.title: Long exchange
long_exchange.description: Exchange where you buy the perpetual (the leg with the negative funding rate).

long_symbol.title: Long symbol
long_symbol.description: Exchange-native symbol of the long leg. Naming differs per venue.

short_exchange.title: Short exchange
short_exchange.description: Exchange where you short the perpetual (the leg with the positive funding rate).

short_symbol.title: Short symbol
short_symbol.description: Exchange-native symbol of the short leg.

long_rate_pct.title: Long funding rate %
long_rate_pct.description: Funding rate on the long leg, in percent per funding interval. Negative means longs receive funding.

short_rate_pct.title: Short funding rate %
short_rate_pct.description: Funding rate on the short leg, in percent per funding interval.

spread_pct_per_period.title: Spread % per period
spread_pct_per_period.description: Difference between the two funding rates, in percent, per funding interval.

apr_pct.title: Annualized return %
apr_pct.description: Spread extrapolated to a full year assuming the rate persists. Treat as an upper bound, not a guarantee.

funding_interval_h.title: Funding interval (h)
funding_interval_h.description: Hours between funding settlements on this pair. 8 is the most common.

next_funding_ts.title: Next funding timestamp
next_funding_ts.description: Unix timestamp in seconds of the next settlement, or 0 when the venue does not expose it.

overview.title: Arbitrage opportunities
overview.description: Cross-exchange funding-rate spreads ranked by annualized return.
